destination.name: Hilton Amsterdam
destination.note: Candidate 2 of the big-o lane (listed as an anonymous 49 m 1962 pand, rijksmonument 532205). Identity confirmed from the RCE register entry (Apollolaan 138, Hilton Hotel) and Wikipedia. No installed model, native-kit POI, poi-work-queue task, backlog destination or OSM landmark covered the pand (checked by name and BAG id), so a model-local landmarkId is used, as for Hotel Jakarta.

sources.note: RCE register description: ground floor with entrance under a far-projecting canopy; recessed constructive intermediate floor; nine-storey bed block; slabs visible as horizontal bands on front and rear, side facades clad in decorative concrete; dark piers between windows; windowless lift and stair bay in grey glazed brick; corner-room balconies alternating between front and side; lift shaft above the roof; 'HILTON' now on the lift tower.
Opened 9 May 1962, architect Hugh Maaskant, V-shaped plan; Lennon and Ono Bed-In 25-31 March 1969, presidential suite room 902 (renumbered 702).

measuredBy.3dbag: NL.IMBAG.Pand.0363100012078084 LoD2.2: chevron slab (apex north at x about -11, arms to x -51 and x +26) 38.1 m above ground, 41.6 m cores, 49.2 m plant box over the lift core, podium 6-11 m.
measuredBy.storeys: nine bed storeys on a 3.34 m pitch from y 8.0 to 38.1 (3DBAG wall base 7.9 m, roof 38.0 m; RCE: nine-storey bed block above a recessed intermediate floor), window ribbon module about 4.7 m (8 cells counted between the west gable and the lift core in the 2025 south panorama).
measuredBy.liftCore: the windowless bay of the south front sits on 3DBAG wall 303 (x -6.1..2.3, 8.5 m), located by projecting the panorama bearing of the blank brick field onto the plan; the plant box above it carries the HILTON lettering (position on the tower inferred, RCE gives no height).

photoSource: Amsterdam municipal panoramas (api.data.amsterdam.nl/panorama/thumbnail/<id>/, perspective crops aimed at the target; heading and fov recorded by big-camshot/shot scripts). Licence: CC0 / municipal open data.
limitations: The west gable and the courtyard faces have no photograph (no panorama after 2020 stands west or inside the V), so they reuse the south-front module and the east-gable treatment: INFERRED.
The north podium (restaurant) is modelled as a generic glazed band with a concrete overhang from 3DBAG heights; the 2021 photo shows a lower, curved glass pavilion.
Corner balconies on the tower ends alternate by storey in the model; the exact alternation was not counted.
The 'HILTON' lettering position on the lift tower is inferred; colour guessed.
The kinked north faces are faceted as in 3DBAG; the real curve is smooth.
